market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$103, dip to $85 means ~17% drop in May. Such a deep move would need full geopolitical resolution AND demand weakness or OPEC supply increase. Unlikely within ~26 days given embedded Iran risk premium.
assessment.key_uncertainty: OPEC+ policy meeting outcomes and demand data
